heroSubtitle: 15 years of LED expertise, delivering innovative display solutions to over 100 countries worldwide.
introDesc: Shenzhen Leekono Optoelectronics Technology Co., Ltd. is a professional LED display manufacturer located in Shenzhen, China. Covering approximately 2,000 square meters of production space, we have been dedicated to the LED display industry for over 15 years. Our products are widely exported to developed countries and regions across Europe, America, the Middle East, and Southeast Asia, with overseas sales exceeding 60% of total revenue. To date, we have delivered premium products and outstanding services to clients in more than 100 countries and regions worldwide.

timeline.2011: Founded in Shenzhen, starting with indoor LED display manufacturing
timeline.2014: Expanded product line to include outdoor and rental LED displays
timeline.2016: Passed CE, FCC, and RoHS certifications, entering European and American markets
timeline.2018: Products exported to over 50 countries, overseas sales surpassing 50%
timeline.2020: Upgraded factory to 2,000㎡, introduced automated production lines
timeline.2022: Launched innovative transparent and crystal LED display series
timeline.2024: Serving 100+ countries with 1,100+ trusted partners globally
timeline.2025: Continuing to innovate with flexible, interactive, and energy-efficient LED solutions
